description: Kernel tunables (sysctl.d drop-in) applied to every machine of a run.

fields.description: Swap aggressiveness, 0..200 (kernel default 60). Benchmarks keep it at 1: swapping falsifies latency.
fields.name: vm_swappiness
fields.title: vm.swappiness

fields.description: 0 = heuristic (kernel default), 1 = always overcommit, 2 = strict (CommitLimit = swap + ratio% RAM).
fields.name: vm_overcommit_memory
fields.title: vm.overcommit_memory

fields.description: Percent of physical RAM added to swap to form CommitLimit; only read when vm.overcommit_memory = 2.
fields.name: vm_overcommit_ratio
fields.title: vm.overcommit_ratio

fields.description: Percent of available memory of dirty pages at which a writing process itself starts writeback (kernel default 20).
fields.name: vm_dirty_ratio
fields.title: vm.dirty_ratio

fields.description: Percent of available memory of dirty pages at which the background flusher starts (kernel default 10).
fields.name: vm_dirty_background_ratio
fields.title: vm.dirty_background_ratio

fields.description: Maximum number of memory-map areas per process (kernel default 65530).
fields.name: vm_max_map_count
fields.title: vm.max_map_count

fields.description: Number of pre-allocated persistent huge pages; 0 leaves huge pages unused (kernel default 0).
fields.name: vm_nr_hugepages
fields.title: vm.nr_hugepages

fields.description: Maximum size of one System V shared-memory segment, bytes. Unset leaves the kernel default (ULONG_MAX on 64-bit).
fields.name: kernel_shmmax
fields.title: kernel.shmmax

fields.description: Total System V shared memory the system may allocate, in PAGES (not bytes). Unset leaves the kernel default.
fields.name: kernel_shmall
fields.title: kernel.shmall

fields.description: System V semaphore limits, four integers "SEMMSL SEMMNS SEMOPM SEMMNI".
fields.name: kernel_sem
fields.title: kernel.sem

fields.description: System-wide maximum number of open file handles.
fields.name: fs_file_max
fields.title: fs.file-max

fields.description: Maximum number of outstanding async I/O requests system-wide (kernel default 65536); raised for io_uring/AIO storage engines.
fields.name: fs_aio_max_nr
fields.title: fs.aio-max-nr

fields.description: Maximum accept-queue length per listening socket (kernel default 4096 since 5.4).
fields.name: net_core_somaxconn
fields.title: net.core.somaxconn

fields.description: Maximum receive socket buffer a program may request with SO_RCVBUF, bytes.
fields.name: net_core_rmem_max
fields.title: net.core.rmem_max

fields.description: Maximum send socket buffer a program may request with SO_SNDBUF, bytes.
fields.name: net_core_wmem_max
fields.title: net.core.wmem_max

fields.description: Seconds an idle TCP connection waits before the first keepalive probe (kernel default 7200).
fields.name: net_ipv4_tcp_keepalive_time
fields.title: net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time

fields.description: Seconds between keepalive probes (kernel default 75).
fields.name: net_ipv4_tcp_keepalive_intvl
fields.title: net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl

fields.description: Unacknowledged keepalive probes before the connection is dropped (kernel default 9).
fields.name: net_ipv4_tcp_keepalive_probes
fields.title: net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes

fields.description: Ephemeral port range for outgoing connections, "<first> <last>" (kernel default "32768 60999").
fields.name: net_ipv4_ip_local_port_range
fields.title: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range

fields.description: /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled. Databases with their own buffer pools want never or madvise.
fields.name: transparent_hugepage
fields.title: Transparent hugepages

fields.description: Any further sysctl key → value, appended verbatim after the known keys.
fields.name: custom
fields.title: Extra sysctl keys

fields.description: Derived: the custom map as sysctl.conf lines.
fields.name: custom_lines
fields.title: Rendered custom lines
